newsitem.title: USA: ECC International adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: ECC International adopts rights plan.

text.p: ECC International Corp said Wednesday it has adopted a shareholder rights plan in which preferred stock purchase rights will be distributed next month as a dividend at one-for-one rate.
The distribution will take place September 17 for common stock outstanding at the close of business that day.
Each right will allow holders of common stock to buy 1/1000 of a share of new series of junior participating preferred stock at an exercise price of $40.

The rights will be extended only if an individual or group acquires 22.5 percent or more of the ECC's common stock, or announces a tender or exchange offer for 22.5 percent or more of the common stock.
The company said the plan is designed to prevent a hostile takeover and to prevent a potential buyer from gaining control of the company without offering a "fair price" to stockholders.
The new rights plan replaces one that expires September 17. The new rights plan is set to expire September 17, 2006.
